FIRST PUBLIC BUILDING IN U.S.
TO INSTALL ELECTRIC STARS AND STRIPES.

The Tolso(Chio) Courthouse was one of the first public buildings in America on which was executed an electrically lighted flag to carry its lesson of patriotism by night as well as by day. Public officials say that the electric flag is most impressive, because it burns its folds into the eye of the passerby in contrast with the dark background. The idea of the electric flag was originated by E.L.Frantz of Cleveland and thus for a number of cities have already adopted the idea. In Sandusky, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Akron, Youngstown Massillon and in Galveston and Denbury as well as Allentown and Newcastle, these electric flags have been installed. "Every #%#%# foreigner" says Mr: Frantz should become an American citizen and believe in AMERICA, FIRST, LAST AND ALL THE TIME.1/18/

General Réverard confers the Legion of Honour on Lieutenant Kula for gallantry on the battlefield. The ceremony took place in the grounds of the historic Chateau de Maintenance, which was given by Louis XIV. to his beautiful favourite, Mme. de Maintenance. The chateau has now been converted into a hospital for wounded officers.
